title: Human Superintelligence Readiness Index (HSRI): Empirical Benchmark, Psychometric Foundation, and Transition Evidence Map
description: Comprehensive empirical benchmark, psychometric architecture, and transition evidence map for national preparedness under advanced AI (v1.1.0 release). Synthesizes 780 macro observations across 39 nations, a 9-paradigm behavioral experiment battery (N=1,080), 4-factor latent CFA, cross-cultural scalar invariance (N=2,000), longitudinal stability (N=600), 7-provider frontier multi-agent consensus, in-situ operator oversight across 4 sectors, OECD/JRC econometric audit, dynamic Kalman ingestion, and ASI transition simulation batteries.
